title: The Set Rule picker lists five rules in two groups
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click tier A's row on the Tiers list.
  3. Check matrix A.
  4. Open the bar's rule picker.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Tier A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Tier A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The bar shows the picker on % Off.

Step 4:

  • The picker lists a group Off default price with % Off and $ Off, then a group From cost with + $, Markup % and Margin %.
  • It has no Previous tier option, only those five.
  • The bar has a Set Rule button and no Set Rule For Entire Tier button.
